integrity: Finite proof, explicit 16-route witness table, and two complete dependency-free executable tests are provided; no extrapolation to other graphs.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns only the 14-vertex Heawood graph in the all-guards-move model. Minimum-state counting by itself is not asserted original; only the exact transition-graph isomorphism, derived optimal defense, and accompanying metric are the new target. Indexed searches cannot prove universal priority. Relevant last pages of one paper were unavailable. Neither independent external audit nor independent validation has been performed.
title: The optimal simultaneous-guard shift graph of the Heawood graph is the complement of its line graph
